info.name: Eruvaaka Subscription and Coupon Local Tests
info.description: Focused local checks for subscription expiry status and Razorpay test-only coupons. Prerequisites: apply database_export.sql, set RAZORPAY_TEST_MODE=true, RAZORPAY_TEST_AMOUNT=2, and Razorpay rzp_test_ credentials in .env. Start the API locally. Set token and user_id below from a verified account. SAVE50 should quote INR 1 off an INR 2 plan (INR 1 final); SAVE25 should quote INR 0.50 off (INR 1.50 final).

exec: pm.test('Subscription status request succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('New expiry fields are present', function () { pm.expect(response.is_subscribed).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(response).to.have.property('expiry_date'); pm.expect(response).to.have.property('days_remaining'); pm.expect(response.show_expiry_notification).to.be.a('boolean'); });
if (response.is_subscribed && response.days_remaining <= 60) { pm.test('Expiry notification window is active', function () { pm.expect(response.show_expiry_notification).to.eql(true); }); }
pm.test('SAVE50 quote succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(response.valid).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('SAVE50 is 50 percent off INR 2 test pricing', function () { pm.expect(response.original_amount).to.eql(2); pm.expect(response.discount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(response.final_amount).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('SAVE25 quote succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(response.valid).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('SAVE25 is 25 percent off INR 2 test pricing', function () { pm.expect(response.original_amount).to.eql(2); pm.expect(response.discount).to.eql(0.5); pm.expect(response.final_amount).to.eql(1.5); });

item.name: Create Razorpay Test Order with SAVE50

exec: pm.test('Order amount is INR 1 after SAVE50', function () { pm.expect(response.original_amount).to.eql(2); pm.expect(response.discount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(response.final_amount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(response.order.amount).to.eql(100); });
